The scores from the paths suggest a consistent pattern of interaction, with varying levels of confidence in the relationships. The evidence points to a possible mechanistic link where Npc172494 may influence the activity of the Synaptic vesicular amine transporter through the regulation of Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B. However, the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct relationship.
